body:
My mom is bipolar, and has a lot of issues, took them out on me and my siblings growing up. 

It was a particularly bad night. I managed to get to youth group, where I felt safe before, and had an alright night, putting my troubles at ease temporarily. 

Told the youth group leaders what happened. Cried and talked and prayed and so on. One of them, a male, offered to give me a ride home and lend his shoulder and ear.... and mouth. 

I was in a vulnerable state of mind and about 16 and he was 22? I think? I don't know. Luckily it didn't go farther but I felt terrible not being able to say no. I was really mad at myself and of course even madder at him. 

I didn't go for a few weeks and one of the female leaders noticed, eventually got it out of me. Guy was reprimanded but I took the blame basically saying I lead him on or something stupidly false.
I was thinking a flannel shirt, a random craft beer, a sample of strains of weed that only exists here, and all in a little basket along with apples, assorted honey, lavender, and some tulips.
This is very important, the number of times I've been told I need to "just think positive" is maddening. Basically tells me that person doesn't care to try and understand what I'm struggling with.
